recommendation: Keep this source fix. It closes the directly checkable FHIR-3636 consistency gap for the current active Patient compartment while leaving broader indirect Group-to-Patient compartment membership questions to their pending Jira trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-3636 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and asked that every resource in the Patient compartment have a patient search parameter so callers can use a consistent parameter name despite resource-specific patient-link element names.
initial_application: The Jira comments record editor approval on the 2014-10-29 MnM call and application in SVN revision 3288, with all then-current cases considered obvious. No converted Git commit mentions FHIR-3636, but current source already had patient search parameters and the clinical-patient common registry for all other active non-root Patient-compartment resources.
additional_context: The current Patient compartment matrix includes active Group membership through member and active Schedule membership through actor, and both reference elements can target Patient. The Patient resource itself remains a compartment root handled by the compartment identity/{def} rule rather than by a self-referential patient search parameter. Later Jira issues FHIR-56547 and FHIR-57217 discuss broader indirect Patient-compartment questions but are unresolved and do not contradict this direct fix.
reconciliation: Added Group-patient and Schedule-patient reference SearchParameters filtered to Patient targets, and added Group and Schedule to the clinical-patient common SearchParameter base list.
source_changes: source/group/bundle-Group-search-params.xml: added Group-patient with expression Group.member.entity.where(resolve() is Patient) and target Patient.
source/schedule/bundle-Schedule-search-params.xml: added Schedule-patient with expression Schedule.actor.where(resolve() is Patient) and target Patient.
source/searchparameter/common-search-parameters.xml: added Group and Schedule to the clinical-patient common SearchParameter base list.

related_jiras.note: Cited by the seed as the companion element-naming discussion; it explains why element names can remain resource-specific while search parameters use a common patient name.
Unresolved later AppointmentResponse concern about Patient-compartment membership; not a final source-edit decision for this reconciliation.
Unresolved later concern about indirect Patient-compartment membership through Group; this commit only adds direct Patient-targeted search parameters.
